description.en:
Basic Attack

Sanhua performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Sanhua consumes STA to launch attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Sanhua consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Sanhua melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Glacio DMG.

Heavy Attack

Sanhua mengonsumsi STA untuk melancarkan serangan, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Sanhua mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-Air Plunging Attack, memberikan Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en: Sanhua sends an air blade to create 1 Ice Prism on the ground, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id: Sanhua mengirim bilah angin untuk menciptakan 1 Ice Prism di tanah, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en: Sanhua deals Glacio DMG and creates 1 Glacier.
description.id: Sanhua memberikan Glacio DMG dan menciptakan 1 Glacier.

description.en: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Resonance Skill is increased by 20% for 8s after casting her Intro Skill.
description.id: Damage yang diberikan Resonance Skill Sanhua meningkat sebesar 20% selama 8 dtk setelah ia melancarkan Intro Skill.

description.en: Damage dealt by Sanhua's Forte Circuit Ice Burst is increased by 20% for 8s after casting Basic Attack 5.
description.id: Damage yang diberikan Forte Circuit Ice Burst Sanhua meningkat sebesar 20% selama 8 dtk setelah melancarkan Basic Attack 5.

description.en: Sanhua swings her blade downward and creates 1 Ice Thorn, dealing Glacio DMG.
description.id: Sanhua mengayunkan bilahnya ke bawah dan menciptakan 1 Ice Thorn, memberikan Glacio DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Detonate

When holding Basic Attack, a cursor moves back and forth on the Forte Gauge. Release Basic Attack while cursor falls in the "Frostbite" area, to perform Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Ice Burst

Sanhua's Heavy Attack Detonate detonates all "Ice Thorns", "Ice Prisms" and "Glaciers" within her attack range, dealing Glacio DMG. Ice Burst deals Resonance Skill DMG.

Frostbite Area

The "Frostbite" area expands with every 1 stack of "Clarity". "Clarity" stacks up to 2 times.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon performing Basic Attack 5.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Intro Skill Freezing Thorns.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Skill Eternal Frost.
Sanhua obtains 2 stack(s) of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Liberation Glacial Gaze.
Upon casting Heavy Attack Detonate, all "Clarity" is removed.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Detonate

Saat menahan Basic Attack, kursor bergerak bolak-balik pada Forte Gauge. Lepas Basic Attack saat kursor berada di area "Frostbite" untuk melakukan Heavy Attack Detonate, memberikan Glacio DMG yang dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Ice Burst

Heavy Attack Detonate Sanhua meledakkan seluruh "Ice Thorns", "Ice Prisms", dan "Glaciers" dalam jangkauan serangannya, memberikan Glacio DMG. Ice Burst memberikan Resonance Skill DMG.

Frostbite Area

Area "Frostbite" meluas setiap 1 stack "Clarity". "Clarity" bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.
Sanhua mendapat 1 stack "Clarity" saat melakukan Basic Attack 5.
Sanhua mendapat 1 stack "Clarity" saat melancarkan Intro Skill Freezing Thorns.
Sanhua mendapat 1 stack "Clarity" saat melancarkan Resonance Skill Eternal Frost.
Sanhua mendapat 2 stack "Clarity" saat melancarkan Resonance Liberation Glacial Gaze.
Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack Detonate, seluruh "Clarity" dihapus.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: The incoming Resonator has their Basic Attack DMG Amplified by 38% for 14s or until they are switched out.
description.id: Basic Attack DMG Resonator yang masuk di-Amplify sebesar 38% selama 14 dtk atau hingga diganti keluar.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Basic Attack V increases Sanhua's Crit. Rate by 15% for 10s.
description.id: Basic Attack V meningkatkan Crit. Rate Sanhua sebesar 15% selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Heavy Attack Detonate STA cost is reduced by 10. When Sanhua casts Resonance Skill Eternal Frost, her resistance to interruption is enhanced for 10s.
description.id: Biaya STA Heavy Attack Detonate berkurang 10. Saat Sanhua melancarkan Resonance Skill Eternal Frost, ketahanannya terhadap interupsi meningkat selama 10 dtk.

description.en: Sanhua's damage dealt is increased by 35% against targets with HP below 70%.
description.id: Damage yang diberikan Sanhua meningkat sebesar 35% terhadap target dengan HP di bawah 70%.

description.en:
Resonance Liberation Glacial Gaze restores 10 Resonance Energy.
DMG of the next Heavy Attack Detonate within 5s is increased by 120%.
description.id:
Resonance Liberation Glacial Gaze memulihkan 10 Resonance Energy.
DMG Heavy Attack Detonate berikutnya dalam 5 dtk meningkat sebesar 120%.

description.en: Crit. DMG of Forte Circuit Ice Burst is increased by 100%. Ice Creations (Ice Thorn, Ice Prism, and Glacier) will explode even if they are not detonated.
description.id: Crit. DMG Forte Circuit Ice Burst meningkat sebesar 100%. Ice Creations (Ice Thorn, Ice Prism, dan Glacier) akan meledak meskipun tidak diledakkan.

description.en: After an Ice Prism or a Glacier is detonated, all team members' ATK is increased by 10% for 20s, stacking up to 2 times.
description.id: Setelah Ice Prism atau Glacier diledakkan, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 10% selama 20 dtk, bertumpuk hingga 2 kali.
